as_told.title: C. D. Jackson visits the Hills

plain: Two weeks after Betty and Barney Hill, a New Hampshire couple, had what Michels calls their famous 1961 encounter, a man named Charles Douglas "C.D." Jackson showed up at their house, according to Michels. Michels tells this himself on three episodes without naming a source: once he links Jackson to the magazine publisher Henry Luce, and once he describes Jackson as a man who ran psychological warfare and was deeply involved in MK Ultra, the CIA's secret mind-control research programme, though there he does not give the two-week timing. If true, it would mean a psychological warfare figure was taking a close and quick interest in the case.
